title: Grab and lock boxes
summary: Give hiders hands. Boxes block sight, and a locked box stays where it was put.

steps.title: Pick up boxes
steps.body:
Every room has four boxes: two cubes and two long planks. Boxes block sight, so a hider behind one is hidden. Players can also carry them to build cover.

While its grab output is above 0, a player picks up the nearest free box in front of it and carries it. When the output drops, it lets go. Both teams can carry boxes.

Pass `brain.grab` to `act`. The test hider walks to the boxes during prep, so the check counts how many it picks up.

check.message: A player should pick up at least one box in the test match.

hints: Swap the grab 0 for the brain's grab output.
Change the line to act(move: brain.move, turn: brain.turn, grab: brain.grab, lock: 0).

steps.title: Lock them in place
steps.body:
A box the hider carried into place can be carried away again, and seekers can shove boxes too. A shelter needs boxes that stay put.

Only hiders can lock, and only with empty hands. Each time the lock output rises above 0, a hider locks the free box in front of it, and then nobody can move that box. Pressing lock again in front of it unlocks it.

Pass `brain.lock` to `act` as well. The test hider sets each box down after a second and locks it.

check.message: The hider should lock at least one box in the test match.

hints: It is the last 0 left in the act line.
Change the line to act(move: brain.move, turn: brain.turn, grab: brain.grab, lock: brain.lock).

steps.title: A room with a shelter
steps.body:
The `each generation` block runs once per generation, after every match is over, and sets the rules for the next generation. One rule is where to play. `useLayout` adds a room to the list, and the rounds of a generation take turns through it.

The open room is empty, so the only cover is what the hider builds. The shelter room has a half room in one corner with a single doorway, and one plank can seal it.

Add an `each generation` block at the end of the script with `useLayout(id: "open")` and `useLayout(id: "shelter")`. Test matches play in the first room on the list.

check.message: Add an each generation block that calls useLayout.

hints: It has the same shape as each tick: the words each generation, then lines inside braces.
Add each generation { } at the end with useLayout(id: "open") and useLayout(id: "shelter") inside, one per line.
